# MethylPipeline User Manual

## What this manual is

This is the operational companion to the theory book. It is designed for execution teams who need:

- exact commands,
- required config keys,
- expected output artifacts,
- stage handoff checks,
- recovery actions when a run fails.

For statistical background, use `docs/theory/`.

## Reading paths

- **Fast path (stage execution):** Chapters `04` to `08`.
- **New project setup:** Chapters `01`, `02`, then `04`.
- **Daily operations:** Chapters `09` to `11`.
- **Scaling MC across machines / optional hyperparameter tuning:** Chapters `12` and `13` (shared `/work` storage, queue subcommands, and the `methyl-hyperparam-search` grid driver).
- **Standalone package usage:** Chapter `03`.

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  >=Latex,
  node distance=1.9cm,

\node[stage] (setup) {Setup};
\node[stage, right=of setup] (stability) {Stability};

\node[stage, right=of freeze] (model) {Model};
\node[stage, right=of model] (postmodel) {Post-model\\Validation};
\node[stage, below=1.2cm of model] (blind) {Blind\\Prediction};

\draw[->] (setup) -- (stability);

\draw[->] (freeze) -- (model);
\draw[->] (model) -- (postmodel);
\draw[->] (model) -- (blind);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

## Scope boundaries

- `methyl-validation` orchestrates stability, freeze, model, and post-model validation.
- Blind-only prediction is documented as a standalone `methyl-predictor` operation.
- Package behavior is documented from implementation in `packages/*`.
